title: External Login: Let Users Sign In With Other Accounts | Orchard Core
description:
Visitors who already have an account with another service must create and remember a separate account for your site.

The External Authentication feature lets them sign in with the account they have, and your site keeps a local user for each of them. This video shows how a provider feature turns External Authentication on, what the login page and the first sign-in look like, and the registration and login settings that control it.

In this video:
• How external authentication works
• Enabling a provider feature
• The login page and its provider button
• Registration settings
• The first sign-in of a visitor
• Login settings
